mentions.name: MiniMaHost
mentions.description: A hosting service that lets customers run their own Mac mini and access it with a dedicated IP address for any purpose, designed for self-hosters who have outgrown residential internet limitations.
mentions.problem: Self-hosting at home runs into limitations like fluctuating IP addresses, limited residential upload speeds, and electricity problems, while dedicated servers on AWS are expensive and storage costs are high.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I started a local business that allows you to run your own mac mini and access it with a dedicated ip for whatever purpose you would like: https://www.minimahost.com/
